# GrowthBook + The Home Depot: Pricing Review
Date: 2026-11-10 | Duration: 25m

## Summary
Home Depot plans to select two vendors for initial POCs and expects a final vendor decision in Q1. Evaluation will focus on roadmap and ecosystem fit, performance impact, product analytics, customization, agentic capabilities, and data-warehouse-native architecture; cost is excluded. The GrowthBook demo was well received, particularly its open-source model and customization potential. Product analytics support BigQuery connections, funnels, trend tracking, and plain-language AI questions without a running experiment, while governance includes pre-launch checklists and custom roles for experiment creation and approval. Broad adoption requires fast workflows, support for centralized and nontechnical users, and customizable Home Depot guardrails. GrowthBook offered a free, nonbinding POC, typically lasting four weeks, with dedicated support and implementation assistance. The POC is expected to start in January after NDA execution, engineering approval, CSA, a separate POC SOW, and internal approvals. Scott will remain the primary contact.

## Keywords
GrowthBook, experimentation platform, product analytics, open source, POC, warehouse-native analytics
